request_data.content:
Users: id, email, name, created_at
Orders: id, user_id, total_amount, status, created_at
Products: id, name, description, price, stock_quantity
OrderItems: id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price
Reviews: id, user_id, product_id, rating, comment
Categories: id, name, parent_id
ProductCategories: product_id, category_id

metadata.mermaid_code:
erDiagram
    Users {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR email
        VARCHAR name
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Orders {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR user_id FK
        DECIMAL total_amount
        VARCHAR status
        DATETIME created_at
    }

    Products {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR name
        VARCHAR description
        DECIMAL price
        INT stock_quantity
    }

    OrderItems {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR order_id FK
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        INT quantity
        DECIMAL unit_price
    }

    Reviews {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR user_id FK
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        INT rating
        VARCHAR comment
    }

    Categories {
        VARCHAR id PK
        VARCHAR name
        VARCHAR parent_id FK
    }

    ProductCategories {
        VARCHAR product_id FK
        VARCHAR category_id FK
    }

    Users ||--o{ Orders : "places"
    Orders ||--o{ OrderItems : "contains"
    Products ||--o{ OrderItems : "included in"
    Users ||--o{ Reviews : "writes"
    Products ||--o{ Reviews : "has"
    Categories ||--o{ Categories : "has sub-categories"
    Products ||--o{ ProductCategories : "categorized in"
    Categories ||--o{ ProductCategories : "contains products"}
